stats.kmMeasured: {{km}} km from the ticket or drawn
stats.hoursDesc: Only crossings with both departure and arrival times.
stats.loadError: The ferry statistics could not be loaded.

crossings.unit: A crossing: one ferry from the departure to the arrival port. Every completed crossing counts once.
crossings.time: Counted in the year it left on the departure port's calendar.
crossings.source: Your ferry crossings with the status “completed”. A crossing is completed once its arrival is past.
crossings.coverage: Every completed crossing has a departure date, so it always counts. Without a time zone at the departure port, the day is read in UTC.
crossings.exclusions: Planned, running and cancelled crossings do not count.

km.unit: Kilometres of the completed crossings, split by what they measure: from the ticket or along a drawn route, or the straight line between the ports.
km.time: In the year of departure on the departure port's calendar.
km.source: Each crossing's stored distance; without one, the straight line between the ports.
km.coverage: A crossing without a stored distance adds nothing.
km.exclusions: Planned, running and cancelled crossings do not count. The straight line is never passed off as the distance sailed.

hours.unit: Hours between departure and arrival, summed over every completed crossing.
hours.time: In the year of departure on the departure port's calendar.
hours.source: Each crossing's departure and arrival time, each in its port's time zone.
hours.coverage: Only crossings with both times; when none has both, this shows “–” rather than 0.
hours.exclusions: Date-only, arrival-less and cancelled crossings do not count.

countries.unit: A country a departure or arrival port lies in, counted once.
countries.time: Countries of the crossings that left in the picked year.
countries.source: Each port's country as the place search returned it.
countries.coverage: A port without a known country adds none.
countries.exclusions: Planned, running and cancelled crossings do not count.
